summary: Verified the hover fix for the 'Add Family Job' and 'Add Payday Job' submit buttons on /my-jobs. Logged in as wallet_demo_child via API, seeded session_token, dismissed the welcome tour, opened each add-job form, and read computed styles pre-hover and on hover.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Family job submit button (data-testid='job-add-btn') pre-hover bg rgb(238,108,77) -> hover rgb(221,91,60) (#DD5B3C), text rgb(255,255,255). Payday job submit pre-hover rgb(255,210,63) -> hover rgb(245,197,24) (#F5C518), text rgb(29,53,87). Neither hover background becomes white; white/dark text remains fully visible. Fix works as intended.
rca of the issue: shadcn Button default variant applied hover:bg-primary/90 which overrode the custom orange/yellow background on hover, resulting in white bg + white text (invisible). Fix added explicit hover:bg-[#DD5B3C] and hover:bg-[#F5C518] classes on the job-add-btn to keep custom accent color on hover. Verified via getComputedStyle on hover.
